# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

Contributors and maintainers pledge to make participation in this learning
project free from harassment and welcoming regardless of age, body size,
visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender
identity and expression, experience, education, socioeconomic status,
nationality, appearance, race, caste, color, religion, or sexual identity and
orientation.

## Standards

Be respectful, accept constructive feedback, take responsibility for mistakes,
and protect other people's private information. Harassment, sexualized conduct,
trolling, personal attacks, and publication of private information are not
acceptable.

## Scope and enforcement

This policy applies in repository issues, pull requests, discussions, and other
project spaces. Report abusive content through GitHub's reporting tools or ask
the repository owner for a private channel without posting sensitive details.
Maintainers may remove or reject content that violates these standards.
